prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: wrist fracture. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1144; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a sideswipe collision during a lane change on the highway. Insured vehicle contacted claimant vehicle on the driver side rear quarter panel. Claimant reports a wrist injury at scene and was transported by ambulance. Insured states the other vehicle was in the adjacent lane and appeared in the blind spot. Police report requested.

Entry 2: Spoke with claimant by phone. Claimant confirmed they are not represented by an attorney and is handling the claim directly. Claimant describes a fractured wrist and is currently in a cast with follow-up orthopedic care scheduled. Explained the claims process, the coverage review steps, and that medical documentation will be needed before any injury evaluation can be completed.

Entry 3: Received police report. Officer noted both drivers reported the lane change, with the citing officer indicating the insured failed to yield to traffic already in the adjacent lane. Scene photos show paint transfer and scraping on both vehicles consistent with a sideswipe. Witness statement from a passenger in a third vehicle is pending.

Entry 4: Requested itemized medical records and authorization to release records from claimant's treating provider. Claimant returned the signed authorization form. Claimant has submitted an initial ER bill and an orthopedic consult note confirming a distal radius fracture. Reviewing records for consistency with the reported mechanism of injury.

Entry 5: Vehicle inspection completed for both vehicles. Repair estimates received and under review. Liability position remains under evaluation pending the witness statement and final medical records. Claimant has been informed of the next steps and expected timeline for a settlement decision. Follow-up call scheduled.
